name: Sheraton Saigon Grand Opera Hotel
positioning: A District 1 hotel steps from the Saigon Opera House and Nguyen Hue Walking Street, with Grand Opera Tower, a hotel within a hotel with its own lift lobby and private lounge, and a fifth-floor wellness level with a heated saltwater pool
best_for: City explorers who want to walk to the Opera House, Notre-Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office
Travelers who want a separate wing with its own arrival and private lounge in Grand Opera Tower
Guests who keep a wellness routine on the road, with a fifth-floor wellness level and in-room wellness kits in Grand Opera Tower

facts.text: The hotel is at the junction of Dong Khoi Street and Dong Du Street, steps from the Opera House Station on Line 1 Metro.
The hotel is within walking distance of the Opera House, Notre-Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office.
The Salon serves breakfast, afternoon tea, evening cocktails and all-day refreshments for Grand Opera Tower guests.
Grand Opera Tower guests arrive through a lift lobby framed by a living vertical garden and check in at The Salon rather than the main lobby.
Every Grand Opera Tower room includes a wellness kit for yoga and stretching.
The hotel's rooms are decorated with lotus motifs celebrating Vietnam's national flower.
The Presidential Suite is on the 21st floor.
The Presidential Suite has three bedrooms, each with an ensuite bathroom.
The heated outdoor pool's water is kept at 29 degrees year-round.
The pool has cabanas for lounging poolside.
Hai Bar is a rooftop cocktail bar on Level 23, designed for sunset drinks and skyline views.
The concierge team assists with city tours and cultural experiences.

highlights.text: Grand Opera Tower is a hotel within a hotel: a luxury wing of the hotel with its own lift lobby and The Salon, a private lounge for Grand Opera Tower guests.
The hotel is in Ho Chi Minh City's District 1, steps from the Saigon Opera House and Nguyen Hue Walking Street.
Grand Opera Tower rooms are inspired by the neighbouring Saigon Opera House and Vietnamese craftsmanship, with lotus motifs, quatrefoil doors and mother-of-pearl inlay.
The fifth floor is the hotel's wellness level, with a heated saltwater pool, Sheraton Fitness and Evolve Wellness Center.
Rooms have views over Nguyen Hue Walking Street or the Saigon River.

considerations.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
WhataHotel notes the busy downtown location comes with traffic noise.
